value.rationale: Fixed-duration time averaging is a natural physical sensor model. The result completely classifies global optimum placement for all positive noise and all nondegenerate window widths, exhibits a discontinuous transition and an exact triple tie, and distinguishes endpoint-pinned from free-end stochastic trajectories. It is not an arbitrary finite table, a renaming, or an unsupported general engineering improvement.
